_comment: Committed sample: placeholders and comments only. Copy your real values into redact.config.local.json (git-ignored). Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
_secretNames_comment: Extra key/property names whose values are secrets (S04), added to the built-in list. Example: ["badge_pin"].
_nonSecretNames_comment: Names that contain a secret-like word but are not secret (S04 deny-list), added to the built-in list. Compared case-insensitively on the exact name. Example: ["KeyRotationDays"].
_categories_comment: Per-category on/off switches, merged key by key over lower layers. Secret categories cannot be disabled.
